name: ULLIMO
original_description:
Connect your ULLIMO account to find saved tracks and video projects, inspect job results, check token balances and recent usage, and manage projects and versions. Available tools can also estimate supported generation costs and start supported audio or music jobs when you authorize them.

Each connection uses your own ULLIMO account. You choose whether to allow write access. Generation uses your existing ULLIMO tokens and may require an existing subscription. You can revoke access from ULLIMO My Page. Interactive timeline editing, the 3D stage, and mixing controls are available in the ULLIMO web app. External social publishing is excluded from this initial public rollout.
